fields.description: The master switch. With this off the doctypes exist and courses can be authored, but nothing auto-assigns, nothing is emailed, and the learner page reports that training is not yet available. The module ships dormant on purpose.
fields.label: Training Enabled

fields.description: Allow learners to reach courses at /training. Turn this off to keep authoring internal while a first course is being built.
fields.label: Learner Portal Enabled

fields.description: Send assignment, due-date and escalation email. Off by default so a bulk first assignment does not surprise 15 people.
fields.label: Send Notifications

fields.description: Let a course's assignment rules raise assignments automatically when someone is hired or changes department, designation or role profile.
fields.label: Auto-Assign From Rules

fields.description: Notify the escalation role when an assignment stays overdue.
fields.label: Escalate Overdue Assignments

fields.description: Badges, points and streaks. Staff and customers are always scored on separate boards.
fields.label: Gamification

fields.description: Let authors ask Vertex AI to draft quiz questions from lesson content. Drafts are never published unreviewed — an author must accept each one, and submitting a version for review fails while any AI draft is still unreviewed.
fields.label: AI Question Drafting

fields.description: Passing score applied to a new course unless the author overrides it.
fields.label: Default Passing Score

fields.description: How much of a video must be watched before a lesson can be finished. Measures time spent, not attention — see the module README.
fields.label: Default Minimum Watched (%)

fields.description: Days a learner gets to finish a required course after it is assigned.
fields.label: Default Due In (Days)

fields.description: Quiz attempts allowed before a learner needs a manager to reset them. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Default Quiz Attempts

fields.description: Days past the due date before an assignment is escalated.
fields.label: Default Escalate After (Days)

fields.description: Who hears about overdue training when a course does not name its own escalation role.
fields.label: Default Escalation Role

fields.description: How often the player reports watch progress while a video plays.
fields.label: Heartbeat Interval (Seconds)

fields.description: How long progress may sit in cache before it is written to the database. This is also the worst-case progress loss if the site is deployed mid-lesson, because a deploy flushes the cache.
fields.label: Progress Flush Interval (Seconds)

fields.description: An attempt with no heartbeat for this long is treated as abandoned and flushed to the database.
fields.label: Attempt Idle Timeout (Minutes)

fields.description: Cap on the stored watched-ranges per video. Beyond this the smallest gaps are collapsed, which keeps the progress record a few kilobytes however much a learner scrubs around.
fields.label: Max Watched Ranges Per Video

fields.description: The Google Drive folder authors upload training video into.
fields.label: Drive Training Folder ID

fields.description: Private GCS bucket the player streams video from. Video is copied here on publish because a Drive preview frame is cross-origin — the player cannot see into it, so checkpoints and watch coverage would both be impossible.
fields.label: GCS Video Bucket

fields.description: The JSON key for the sa-training-media service account, pasted whole. Stored encrypted and never rendered back. Signs the short-lived playback URLs and performs the Drive-to-bucket copy; it can read and write objects in this one bucket and reach nothing else.
fields.label: GCS Service Account JSON

fields.description: Largest video an author may attach, in megabytes. Recommend 720p — a 60-minute 1080p lesson runs to a gigabyte or more.
fields.label: Max Video Size (MB)

fields.description: How long a signed video URL stays valid. Short enough that a copied link dies quickly; long enough to watch a lesson.
fields.label: Signed URL Lifetime (Minutes)

fields.description: Warn when a technician without a current certification is put on a maintenance visit or task. This only ever warns — it never blocks the save, because by the time it fires a truck is usually already on site and refusing the form would mean the work happens with no record at all.
fields.label: Warn on Uncertified Assignment
